==Summary==

{{pov|[[Elayne Trakand]]}}

Elayne receives reports from [[Norry]]. Deposits of alum have been found on one of her estates which will make it easier to get loans from the bankers to fund the guard force [[Birgitte]] is building. He mentions an attack on Rand in the Sun Palace and no one really knows where he is now.

She is brought her afternoon meal. Afterward [[Dyelin]] reports merchants have spotted a large borderland army when she realizes someone slipped forkroot in her tea. She struggles trying to tell Dyelin , who then attempts to raise the alarm to the guards. Three assassins come in. Dyelin is able to occupy one and stall another until [[Doilin Mellar]] saves the day. Elayne succumbs to the forkroot while mentally calling for Birgitte.
